title: 6 architecture audits completed in one session — caught systemic issues
content: On 2026-03-13, ran 6 audit tasks in sequence: audit-fix-architecture, audit-fix-code-quality, audit-fix-documentation, audit-fix-security, audit-fix-shader-correctness, audit-fix-test-coverage. These caught systemic issues across the codebase including: DX12 type leakage above RHI boundary, missing log categories, inconsistent error handling, documentation gaps, shader compilation warnings, and test coverage below 95% threshold. Running periodic audits is high-value for maintaining quality in a fast-moving AI-developed codebase.
